hep global successfully develops two solar projects
with battery storage systems west of Munich

Güglingen, 31 August 2026 – hep global GmbH (hep global), a specialist in the development of solar projects, has developed two solar projects with integrated battery storage systems in the neighboring districts of Ostallgäu and Unterallgäu. Construction of the “Buchloe” (8.4 MWp) and “Wiedergeltingen” (3.7 MWp) solar parks is scheduled to be completed before the end of this year. Construction is being coordinated by ZaberSolar GmbH.

The two solar parks are located only about 1.5 kilometers apart. Due to their location between the A96 highway and a railroad line, they are considered privileged locations for ground-mounted photovoltaic systems. The intermunicipal location of the Buchloe solar park presented special requirements. “The project area spans two districts in the Allgäu region,” explains Johannes Liepert, Senior Associate for Project Development at hep global. “As such, the project has demonstrated how important early and structured coordination with the authorities and specialized agencies in both jurisdictions is for the success of a complex project.”

solar park is being built on an 8.7-hectare site near a gravel pit. The integrated green energy storage system, with a capacity of 6.1 MWh and an output of 3 MW, expands the technical applications and economic benefits of the electricity generated. Thanks to the storage system, solar power can be fed into the grid specifically during periods of higher electricity prices. The expected annual electricity production is approximately 9.4 million kilowatt-hours, which, according to the Federal Statistical Office, corresponds to the needs of just under 2,780 households.

solar park will have a capacity of 3.7 MWp. The plant will be supplemented by a green energy storage system with a capacity of 2.5 MWh and an output of 1.3 MW. Covering an area of 4.5 hectares, the facility will generate approximately 4.3 million kilowatt-hours of renewable electricity per year. This is enough to supply approximately 1,270 households with electricity.

hep global places great importance on integrating the generated electricity into the regional power grid wherever possible. “Our goal is to make the electricity generated by our solar parks available right where it is produced. Therefore, we reach out to potential local electricity buyers as early as the development phase,” explains Gábor Csanak, Director of PPA Origination EMEA, who is responsible for electricity marketing at hep global.

The hep global Group is an internationally active specialist in the development of solar projects and battery energy storage systems (BESS). For more than 15 years, the owner-managed company from Baden-Württemberg has been developing and planning renewable energy projects, mainly in Europe, Japan and North America. Its strategic focus is on greenfield developments and the integration of BESS. The hep global Group employs around 120 people worldwide with subsidiaries in Germany, Italy, Poland, the USA, Canada and Japan.
